jobs.excerpt: Title: Growth Marketing Manager – Paid Media & Klaviyo (AI-First) Type: Full-time contractor Seniority: Mid-level Salary: USD 55,000–70,000/year + performance bonus Location: Remote — Worldwide, excluding the United States, Canada, United Kingdom and Western Europe.
jobs.description:
Title: Growth Marketing Manager – Paid Media & Klaviyo (AI-First)
Type: Full-time contractor
Seniority: Mid-level
Salary: USD 55,000–70,000/year + performance bonus
Location: Remote — Worldwide, excluding the United States, Canada, United Kingdom and Western Europe. Candidates must be available for at least four hours of overlap with Pacific Time.

About Nectar Life. We're a vertically integrated bath and body brand: handmade, vegan and cruelty-free. We make everything in our own 26,000 sq ft Las Vegas factory and sell it in our own stores on the Las Vegas Strip, Downtown Disney, Universal CityWalk and Waikiki, and online through Shopify.

The role. We're bringing growth in-house. You'll replace our paid-ads agency and own customer acquisition and retention end to end, reporting to the CEO. Your work will move sales visibly, and you'll help build our AI creative workflows from the ground up.

Must-haves (we screen for both first):

  • 3+ years of hands-on Meta Ads Manager work for ecommerce or DTC brands: you built, tested and scaled the campaigns yourself and can show spend, ROAS and CPA.

  • Hands-on Klaviyo: email and SMS flows, segmentation and campaigns you built, with revenue to show for them.

What you'll do:

  • Run Meta and TikTok ads: budgets, audiences, creative testing, scaling winners.

  • Run Klaviyo retention: welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase and win-back flows, plus weekly sends.

  • Produce ad creative with AI tools (image, video, copy), then edit it to match our brand and keep product details accurate.

  • Report weekly on what worked, what didn't and what's next.

You'll stand out if you: have beauty, skincare, fragrance or gifting experience; edit short-form video; build automations with Claude, n8n or Make.

Hours: at least 4 hours overlap with 9am–5pm US Pacific.

Application questions:

  1. Upload a Meta Ads Manager screenshot of campaigns you ran (spend, purchases, ROAS visible).

  2. Upload a screenshot of a Klaviyo flow you built, with its revenue or conversion stats.

  3. Link one ad you made with AI tools and name the tools.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionMaisha Meds is hiring!  We’re seeking an engineering manager to manage our wonderful engineers to build technology to improve healthcare in Africa.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Maisha Meds is hiring! We’re seeking an engineering manager to manage our wonderful engineers to build technology to improve healthcare in Africa.

About Maisha Meds

Maisha Meds is an organization dedicated to improving health care in Africa through best-in-class technology.

Founded in 2017, Maisha Meds has created the largest digital network of private pharmacies and clinics across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Nigeria, and Zambia through our mobile software. Our platform not only helps these providers improve business by making sales, managing inventory, and tracking patients. It also reimburses them for providing high-quality care for malaria, family planning, and HIV prevention at discounted costs.

Maisha Meds logs millions of patient visits every year and has provided hundreds of thousands of reimbursements to date. We harness data from our network of pharmacies and clinics to reveal health and market trends, which allows us to design better solutions that work for the people we serve. We have worked with leading academic institutions such as UC Berkeley, Emory University, and KEMRI to evaluate the effectiveness of our programs. Research shows that our system is able to significantly increase the uptake of long-acting contraceptives and appropriate malaria case management.

Our work is funded by a range of partners including scale-up funding from USAID Development Innovation Ventures and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. This will help Maisha Meds greatly expand its mobile software to 7,500 total pharmacies and clinics by late 2026, delivering subsidized care to nearly a million new patients in the process.

About the role

Maisha Meds builds a point-of-sale Android app for pharmacies to track their sales and manage their inventory and leverage AI to improve directions of use for medicines. On top of the Android app, we have a layer of features to help us run patient programs so that patients visiting pharmacies can receive subsidized care. We also built a suite of back office tools to help our operational staff manage the subsidy programs. This role is for an individual to manage a remote team of engineers across North America, Europe, and Africa, initially managing our patient programs projects team, eventually starting a new team for new projects. Our organization operates in Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, and Tanzania and we would love to have you join us onsite a couple of times a year.

This role is remote (worldwide) with expected travel to our countries of operation. You will report to Chief Technology Officer. The salary range is $90,000 - $160,000 USD commensurate with experience and location.

Responsibilities

People and Team

  • Manage a remote team of 3-6 creative engineers spanning across several projects
  • Foster a welcoming friendly and culture
  • Grow and mentor engineers and help them pursue their career interests
  • Provide good feedback for performance management and coaching
  • Recruiting and hiring for your team when necessary.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership (architecture and design, code reviews, and incident management) to your reports.
  • Independently contribute to projects 20% of your time to gain a deep technical understand of the infrastructure end-to-end.
  • Preferred prior experience with Ruby on Rails and devops with AWS infrastructure.

Product and Project Management

  • While we have product managers at Maisha Meds, at times, you’ll need to engage with stakeholders directly and product manage yourself
  • Translate ambiguous stakeholder desires into concrete requirements and action plans
  • Work across teams and both internal and external stakeholders to execute on projects
  • Understand customers and users and be able to provide product direction

Our Technologies:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Vue.js
  • Android Kotlin

Nice to haves

  1. You have worked at startups as well as mature tech organizations
  2. You have experience in both B2B and B2C environments
  3. You have prior experience in healthcare and/or Africa

Why You Should Join Us

  • On a roll: We are doubling year-over-year with new funding partnerships that are boosting expansion in multiple countries
  • Great team: We are founded, managed, and backed by successful veterans of Stanford School of Medicine, Google, mPharma, and I&M bank. We have technologists, doctors, and economists working side by side to solve difficult problems.
  • Great funders: We’re supported by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, USAID Development Innovation Ventures, CIFF, WHO FIND, and Pfizer to pay for healthcare on behalf of patients, with others to be announced soon.
  • Huge market: We are disrupting a massive, growing $50+ billion market for healthcare payments for low-income patients, with a focus on paying for health outcomes to ensure patients get the best quality care.
  • Great customers: We create financial incentives that ensure our health care providers deliver excellent care.
  • Impact: We have cultivated a fun and exciting start-up culture that empowers its talented staff to make a huge impact.

jobs.title: PR Account Executive (Europe)
jobs.excerpt: Account Executive Working at PRLabAt PRLab we breathe innovation and we are always looking for fresh talent who are just as enthusiastic about a successful PR campaign as we are.
jobs.description:
Account Executive

Working at PRLab

At PRLab we breathe innovation and we are always looking for fresh talent who are just as enthusiastic about a successful PR campaign as we are. In short, we approach this quite differently: we believe in an integrated marketing approach with PR as a prominent factor. This involves multiple touchpoints to reach the target groups of our customers everywhere. We do this proactively; so we don't wait and go to the seams to deliver results and reinvent the concept of “PR”! We are an international team with an HQ in the heart of Amsterdam and offices popping up around the globe.

About the Job

We are seeking a results-driven PR Account Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will bring a PR experience background, a strong media network, and a proven track record of successfully managing and retaining client accounts. This role involves exceed KPIs by implementing clear client strategies, showcasing creativity, taking full ownership of designated markets, collaborating as the main point of contact for market accounts in meetings, delegating market-specific tasks, and providing weekly updates and reports along with weekly meetings to discuss strategy and retention.

What we seek in you:

  • A bachelors or equivalent in PR/Journalism/Communication
  • At least two years of experience in PR or a related field
  • Fluent in English
  • International experience
  • No 9 to 5 mentality; we are a startup and some chaos is part of it!
  • You are interested in language and able to think creatively with words, while maintaining a professional tone
  • Are able to have a professional attitude with clients
  • Can handle client confrontation
  • Are articulate under pressure
  • Attention to detail
  • Are comfortable asking questions while proposing solutions
  • Are ambitious, detail-oriented, positive, decisive, and proactive
  • An interest in B2B, SaaS, Tech and startup industries is desirable

Your duties may include, but are not limited to:

  • Participating in meetings with clients to discuss campaign strategies and goals, then developing a plan to achieve them
  • Communicating with clients to ensure they are satisfied with their campaigns and evaluating progress with the client
  • Reviewing analytics data (including but not limited to competitor tracking) to determine effectiveness of previous campaigns and planning future ones accordingly
  • Developing and maintaining client relationships to ensure satisfaction with services provided by the agency
  • Preparing reports detailing the work performed on each campaign
  • Pitching and newsjacking
  • Media training
  • Writing or revising content
  • Liaising with media, clients, and stakeholders
  • Sometimes developing content for social media accounts and writing blog posts
  • Creation of strategy and planning of things such as content, press releases, etc.
  • Sometimes: Event support (when requested by the client), including finding videographers, photographers, etc.

Why PRLab?

At PRLab, we believe in rewarding excellence. Here's what's in it for you:

🕰️ Remote working

🌴 Individual and corporate incentives including company events, social activities, and unforgettable trips to destinations such as Portugal, Spain, and more!

🏖️ 25 days paid vacation days per year (pro-rata), including statutory days

Diversity & Inclusion ❤️

We have an unwavering commitment to diversity with the aim that every one of our people has a full sense of belonging within our organisation.

As a business imperative, every person at PRLab has the responsibility to create and sustain an inclusive environment. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values.

Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.

Ready to Join PRLab? 🚀

Your journey with us will be defined by clear focus, intensive training, and a comprehensive development program. You'll enjoy a competitive salary complemented by an enticing list of perks and benefits. Our lively office is nestled in the vibrant Amsterdam Central area, easily accessible via public transport. Join our international, diverse, and young team of 14 nationalities for after-work drinks, outdoor adventures, and much more! Don't miss out on this thrilling adventure with PRLab professionals. If this already feels like home to you, seize the opportunity and apply now!

Start Date

We are looking to fill this role as soon as possible on a 6 month fixed term contract plus one month probationary period.

Interview Process

Initially, you will receive a task to complete followed by an invitation for a screening interview. Following that, the Hiring Manager will reach out to you if there are potential synergies between us. Subsequently, there will be a final interview with the CEO, depending on the specific role for which you have applied.

Should you be successful, the freelancer agreement will be sent through to you followed by a detailed onboarding process. You will be guided through each step by our HR and Operations teams.

Salary: 2900 Euros monthly

jobs.title: Executive Assistant - Real Estate
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Executive Partner to support two real estate professionals across their businesses.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Executive Partner to support two real estate professionals across their businesses.

The role focuses on administrative support, CRM management, email and calendar management, scheduling, and task follow-up.

The ideal candidate can understand the context and intent behind a request, take the appropriate next step, and follow through without needing constant step-by-step instructions.

Key ResponsibilitiesAdministrative & Executive Support

  • Manage emails, calendars, and appointments

  • Schedule meetings and calls

  • Coordinate with clients, agents, and business partners

  • Track and follow up on action items

  • Organize information and administrative tasks

  • Provide general operational support to the executives

Email & Communication

  • Monitor and organize incoming emails

  • Identify urgent or important requests

  • Draft responses when needed

  • Track pending requests and follow-ups

  • Ensure important tasks from emails are completed

  • Communicate through email, Google Chat, and text

CRM Management

  • Update and organize contact information

  • Maintain accurate CRM records

  • Support client and agent communications

  • Assist with basic CRM workflows

Primary CRM: Bold Trail – experience is strongly preferred.

Secondary CRM: GoHighLevel – used primarily for agent-facing activities.

Candidates without Bold Trail experience may still be considered if they have strong CRM experience and can learn new platforms quickly.

Scheduling & Calendar Management

  • Schedule and reschedule meetings

  • Coordinate availability

  • Send calendar invitations and meeting links

  • Manage reminders and follow-ups

  • Keep calendars accurate and organized

Event & Training Support

  • Assist with scheduling training sessions and events

  • Coordinate event communications

  • Send reminders

  • Track attendees when needed

  • Handle administrative follow-ups

Task Management

Tasks may come from emails, meetings, Google Chat, text messages, calendars, or direct requests.

The Executive Partner should be able to identify:

What needs to be done → What is needed → What the next step is → When it needs to be completed

Tasks will primarily be managed through Asana.

Requirements

  • Strong written and verbal English

  • Excellent English comprehension

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills

  • Excellent attention to detail

  • Reliable follow-through

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Ability to work independently

  • Comfortable using email, chat, and other digital tools

  • Tech-savvy and willing to learn new systems

  • Ability to understand context and ask questions when clarification is needed

Preferred

  • Executive Assistant or Administrative Assistant experience

  • Real estate experience

  • CRM experience

  • Bold Trail experience

  • GoHighLevel experience

  • Asana experience

  • Email and calendar management experience

  • Scheduling or event coordination experience

  • Experience supporting executives or multiple businesses

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Organized – keeps tasks and information in order

  • Proactive – follows up without constant reminders

  • Detail-oriented – catches important information and deadlines

  • Communicative – provides updates and asks questions when needed

  • Adaptable – learns new tools and processes quickly

  • Tech-savvy – comfortable working across multiple platforms

  • Dependable – follows through on commitments

  • Context-aware – understands the purpose behind a request

  • Independent – can take ownership of tasks with minimal supervision

Tools

  • Bold Trail – Primary CRM

  • GoHighLevel – CRM / agent support

  • Asana – Task management

  • Google Calendar – Scheduling

  • Google Chat – Communication

  • Email – Communication and task management

  • Text – Communication

Experience with every tool is not required. Strong transferable experience and the ability to learn quickly are important.

Important Note

Transaction Coordination is NOT part of this role.

The position is focused on administrative support, CRM management, communication, scheduling, and general operational support.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Executive Partner will:

  • Keep emails and calendars organized

  • Maintain accurate CRM records

  • Stay on top of tasks and follow-ups

  • Coordinate meetings efficiently

  • Support events and training activities

  • Keep Asana tasks updated

  • Learn and become proficient in Bold Trail

  • Reduce the administrative workload of the executives

  • Communicate clearly about priorities and blockers

  • Become a dependable extension of the team
